children: Robert Kiyosaki, author of “Rich Dad Poor Dad,” said he plans to wait for Bitcoin to reach another bottom before buying. According to Foresight News, Kiyosaki advised investors not to “catch a falling knife” and to wait until a market decline ends before entering. He said he began buying Bitcoin at $20,000 per coin after the previous market crash and will wait for another bottom this time. Kiyosaki added that profits are made when buying, not when selling.

title: Robert Kiyosaki Says He Will Wait for Bitcoin to Bottom Again Before Buying
